verseText: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
meaning: We need God to help our hearts love his word more than money or selfish things.

recall.question: God’s “testimonies” are His teachings. Knowing this, what does “Turn my heart to Your testimonies” mean?
choices: Help me trust in God's Word
Help me feel better in my heart

meaning.question: “Covetous gain” means selfishly wanting more for ourselves. What is this prayer asking God to change?

application.prompt: Sometimes wanting more money or new things can matter more to us than listening to God. We can ask Him to change what our hearts love. When have you found it hard to choose God’s way over getting something you wanted?
